boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Ramapo College of New Jersey
boards.description: Ten nearby food destinations with currently published evening hours, selected as under-21-safe restaurant stops.

cards.title: Ramsey Chinese Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 37 W. Main Street, Ramsey, NJ
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s posted dinner window for a pickup or sit-down meal; Friday and Saturday service is listed through 10:30 PM.
cards.short_summary: A Ramsey Main Street Chinese restaurant with a later Friday–Saturday dinner close.
cards.evidence_claim: The restaurant lists its address as 37 W. Main Street, Ramsey, and Friday–Saturday dinner hours from 3:00 PM to 10:30 PM.
cards.source_title: Ramsey Chinese Restaurant — Online Ordering Menu
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday–Saturday dinner service until 10:30 PM; confirm holiday hours before leaving.

cards.title: Houlihan's Ramsey
cards.subtitle: 706 State Route 17, Ramsey, NJ
cards.notes: Plan a Friday or Saturday dinner here when you need a published midnight closing time; use the official location page to check updates.
cards.short_summary: A Route 17 restaurant whose official listing extends to midnight on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Houlihan’s official Ramsey page lists 706 State Route 17 and Friday–Saturday hours of 11:00 AM to 12:00 AM.
cards.source_title: Houlihan's Ramsey — Hours & Location
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists Friday–Saturday hours through 12:00 AM; verify holiday or event changes.

cards.title: Brady's at the Station
cards.subtitle: 5–7 W. Main Street, Ramsey, NJ
cards.notes: Check the food menu and posted hours before heading downtown; the official site lists a late nightly closing schedule for this restaurant.
cards.short_summary: A Ramsey Main Street restaurant with official hours through 2:00 AM Monday through Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Brady’s official food-menu page lists 5–7 W. Main St., Ramsey, and hours of 11:00 AM–2:00 AM Monday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Brady's at the Station — Food Menu and Hours
cards.access_notes: Official page lists closing at 2:00 AM Monday–Saturday and midnight Sunday; food-service timing may differ, so call ahead.

cards.title: RP Prime Steakhouse
cards.subtitle: 209 Ramapo Valley Road, Mahwah, NJ
cards.notes: Reserve or check availability for a Mahwah dinner that has a documented Saturday close of 11:00 PM on its official location page.
cards.short_summary: A Mahwah steakhouse with its latest posted close on Saturday night.
cards.evidence_claim: RP Prime’s official Mahwah page lists 209 Ramapo Valley Road and Saturday hours of 12:00 PM–11:00 PM.
cards.source_title: RP Prime Steakhouse — Mahwah Hours & Location
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Saturday service through 11:00 PM; reservations and holiday hours should be checked directly.

cards.title: Kinchley's Tavern
cards.subtitle: 74 Franklin Turnpike, Ramsey, NJ
cards.notes: Use the official takeout or reservation information for a Friday or Saturday pizza dinner; the posted restaurant hours run through 11:00 PM.
cards.short_summary: A long-running Ramsey pizza restaurant with 11:00 PM Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Kinchley’s official site lists Friday and Saturday hours of 11:00 AM–11:00 PM and states that takeout is available.
cards.source_title: Kinchley's Tavern — Pizza and Italian Food
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday–Saturday hours through 11:00 PM and takeout; confirm closing time before travel.

cards.title: Mahwah Pizza & Pasta
cards.subtitle: 1035 MacArthur Boulevard, Mahwah, NJ
cards.notes: Place a pickup order or visit during the restaurant’s posted Friday–Saturday window, which runs later than its weekday schedule.
cards.short_summary: A Mahwah pizza and pasta stop with official Friday–Saturday hours through 11:00 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Mahwah Pizza & Pasta’s official site lists 1035 MacArthur Blvd. and Friday–Saturday hours of 10:00 AM–11:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Mahwah Pizza & Pasta
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday and Saturday service until 11:00 PM; check the ordering page for any changes.

cards.title: Roxanne's
cards.subtitle: 150 Franklin Turnpike, Mahwah, NJ
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s official ordering option for a Friday or Saturday pickup; its posted operating hours extend to 11:00 PM those nights.
cards.short_summary: A Franklin Turnpike restaurant with an official 11:00 PM Friday–Saturday close.
cards.evidence_claim: Roxanne’s official contact page lists 150 Franklin Turnpike, Mahwah, and Friday–Saturday hours from 11:30 AM to 11:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Roxanne's — Contact and Hours of Operation
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Friday–Saturday hours until 11:00 PM and offers pickup; verify hours before departure.

cards.title: Noor Biryani Indian Grill
cards.subtitle: 33 Lafayette Avenue, Suffern, NY
cards.notes: Consider the posted Friday or Saturday dinner window for halal Indian food; review the official hours before making the cross-border drive.
cards.short_summary: A Suffern halal Indian restaurant with dinner service listed until 10:00 PM Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Noor Biryani’s official site lists 33 Lafayette Ave., Suffern, and Friday and Saturday evening hours ending at 10:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Noor Biryani Indian Grill
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday and Saturday dinner through 10:00 PM; Tuesday is listed as closed.

cards.title: CARS Eatery — Ramsey
cards.subtitle: 114 E. Main Street, Ramsey, NJ
cards.notes: Use the official locations page to time a Friday or Saturday burger-and-shake run; this branch lists a 1:00 AM closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Ramsey burger restaurant with its latest listed hours on Friday and Saturday nights.
cards.evidence_claim: CARS Eatery’s official locations page lists its Ramsey address as 114 E. Main St. and Friday–Saturday hours of 11:00 AM–1:00 AM.
cards.source_title: CARS Eatery — Locations & Hours
cards.access_notes: Official locations page lists Friday–Saturday hours through 1:00 AM; check online ordering for kitchen availability.

cards.title: Sangria Tapas Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 1033 MacArthur Boulevard, Mahwah, NJ
cards.notes: Plan a Friday or Saturday dinner around the published 10:00 PM close, and use the restaurant’s official site for reservation details.
cards.short_summary: A Mahwah tapas restaurant with a posted 10:00 PM close on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Sangria Tapas Restaurant’s official site lists 1033 MacArthur Blvd., Mahwah, and Friday–Saturday hours of 4:00 PM–10:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Sangria Tapas Restaurant
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday and Saturday hours until 10:00 PM; confirm hours for holidays or private events.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named campus stops for studying, meeting, making, viewing art, and moving between classes.

cards.title: Peter P. Mercer Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: George T. Potter Library and reservable study rooms
cards.notes: Reserve a group or media room through the library system, then check in promptly and leave the whiteboard clean for the next users.
cards.short_summary: A library-centered study stop with reservable rooms, media rooms, and individual study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Potter Library in the Peter P. Mercer Learning Commons has study and media rooms for current Ramapo students; rooms include whiteboards and data/power outlets.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms: Reservations and Usage — George T. Potter Library
cards.access_notes: Study rooms are for current Ramapo students and require reservation/check-in; consult the library page for current room hours.

cards.title: Robert A. Scott Student Center
cards.subtitle: Dining, bookstore, and meeting rooms
cards.notes: Use the connected center as a practical meetup point before class; choose a meeting room or dining area that matches your group’s plan.
cards.short_summary: A connected campus hub with dining, bookstore, and meeting-room space.
cards.evidence_claim: The Robert A. Scott Student Center houses the college bookstore, dining areas, and numerous meeting rooms, and connects to the academic buildings.
cards.source_title: Academic Units — Office of Specialized Services
cards.access_notes: Use during building operating hours; individual rooms or services may have separate access rules.

cards.title: The Atrium Food Court
cards.subtitle: Student Center dining area
cards.notes: Make this a clear lunch-and-regroup stop in the Student Center, and check campus dining information before relying on a particular option.
cards.short_summary: The map-listed food-court destination inside the Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo’s campus map lists The Atrium (Food Court) among campus departments and offices.
cards.source_title: Ramapo Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Food purchases may be required; check current dining operations before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Berrie Center for Performing and Visual Arts
cards.title: Berrie Center for Performing and Visual Arts
cards.subtitle: Campus galleries and performance spaces
cards.notes: Check the Berrie Center calendar before going, then pair a scheduled show or gallery visit with time to look around the arts complex.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed performing and visual arts destination with accessible theater seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo identifies the Berrie Center for Performing and Visual Arts on its campus map and notes that it is wheelchair accessible with companion seating in Sharp Theater.
cards.source_title: Academic Units — Office of Specialized Services
cards.access_notes: Event, gallery, and building access vary by schedule; verify the relevant program before visiting.

cards.title: Kresge Gallery
cards.subtitle: Berrie Center gallery stop
cards.notes: Look for the gallery on the campus map, then check current arts listings before planning a viewing stop or bringing a visiting friend.
cards.short_summary: A named campus gallery destination within the arts area.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo’s campus map lists Kresge Gallery among its departments and offices.
cards.source_title: Ramapo Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Exhibitions and gallery access can vary; confirm the current schedule with the College.

cards.title: Pascal Gallery
cards.subtitle: Map-listed campus gallery
cards.notes: Use the campus map to find this gallery, and confirm the current exhibition or opening information before making it part of your route.
cards.short_summary: A second named gallery stop for an art-focused campus walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo’s campus map lists Pascal Gallery among its departments and offices.
cards.source_title: Ramapo Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Exhibition and access details are not stated on the map; verify with the College before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Bill Bradley Sports and Recreation Center
cards.title: Bill Bradley Sports and Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Recreation and interscholastic athletics
cards.notes: Plan an active break around the center’s listed facilities, and ask Recreation or Athletics about current eligibility and open-use times.
cards.short_summary: A student-centered recreation building known as “The Bill.”
cards.evidence_claim: The Bill Bradley Sports and Recreation Center serves Ramapo’s recreational and interscholastic athletic needs and includes fitness, climbing, pool, gym, and multipurpose facilities.
cards.source_title: Sports & Recreation — Ramapo College Virtual Tour
cards.access_notes: Facility access and recreation hours may vary; confirm current policies before arriving.

cards.title: Sharp Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Inside the Bill Bradley Sports and Recreation Center
cards.notes: Bring what you need for a short workout, then confirm current fitness-center access and equipment policies with campus recreation before heading over.
cards.short_summary: The named fitness facility within Ramapo’s recreation center.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo identifies the Sharp Fitness Center as a facility within the Bill Bradley Sports and Recreation Center.
cards.source_title: Sports & Recreation — Ramapo College Virtual Tour
cards.access_notes: Confirm current recreation-center entry rules and fitness-center hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Adele and Reuben Thomas Swimming Pool
cards.title: Adele and Reuben Thomas Swimming Pool
cards.subtitle: Bill Bradley Sports and Recreation Center
cards.notes: Check pool availability before you go, and follow the current recreation-center requirements for swim access and any needed equipment.
cards.short_summary: The named campus pool within the Bradley Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo identifies the Adele and Reuben Thomas Swimming Pool as one of the facilities in the Bill Bradley Sports and Recreation Center.
cards.source_title: Sports & Recreation — Ramapo College Virtual Tour
cards.access_notes: Pool hours, access, and programming may vary; verify current availability with campus recreation.

cards.title: Arch (Havemeyer)
cards.subtitle: Named campus landmark
cards.notes: Add this map-listed landmark to a walking loop between academic stops, and use the campus map to orient yourself before continuing across campus.
cards.short_summary: A named Havemeyer landmark that works as a clear visual waypoint.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo’s campus map lists Arch (Havemeyer) among campus buildings, and the College’s virtual tour includes an Arch campus area.
cards.source_title: Ramapo Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark; use normal campus pedestrian routes and observe any posted restrictions.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented, student-accessible activities with no purchase or admission required.

cards.title: Play pool at J. Lee’s
cards.subtitle: Student Center Annex, SC-226
cards.notes: Bring a few classmates to the Student Center Annex lounge and use the pool table during J. Lee’s posted open hours.
cards.short_summary: A student-lounge pool game with no purchase required.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo lists access to J. Lee’s pool tables among its services for the student activities lounge.
cards.source_title: Center for Student Involvement — J. Lee’s
cards.access_notes: Student lounge; use during J. Lee’s posted open hours.

cards.title: Set up a ping-pong game
cards.subtitle: J. Lee’s, Student Center Annex
cards.notes: Use the lounge’s ping-pong tables for a low-key group game, then return equipment as directed by the attendant.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost table-tennis hang in the student lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo lists access to ping-pong tables among J. Lee’s student-lounge services.
cards.source_title: Center for Student Involvement — J. Lee’s
cards.access_notes: Student lounge; use during J. Lee’s posted open hours.

cards.title: Choose a board game
cards.subtitle: J. Lee’s, Student Center Annex
cards.notes: Meet at J. Lee’s, pick from the available board games, and keep the group session within the lounge’s operating hours.
cards.short_summary: Board-game time using the lounge’s provided games.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo identifies board games as a service available in J. Lee’s.
cards.source_title: Center for Student Involvement — J. Lee’s
cards.access_notes: Student lounge; use during J. Lee’s posted open hours.

cards.entity_name: Wide-screen TV viewing at J. Lee’s
cards.title: Watch something together
cards.subtitle: J. Lee’s, Student Center Annex
cards.notes: Use J. Lee’s wide-screen televisions for a shared viewing break, and check with the lounge attendant about current setup.
cards.short_summary: A communal TV break in a student activities lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo says J. Lee’s is equipped with wide-screen televisions and audio-video equipment.
cards.source_title: Center for Student Involvement — J. Lee’s
cards.access_notes: Student lounge; use during J. Lee’s posted open hours.

cards.entity_name: Yoga-mat relaxation in the Ramapo Wellness Room
cards.title: Reserve a yoga-mat reset
cards.subtitle: Ramapo Wellness Room, E-216
cards.notes: Reserve a 30-minute small-group appointment, sign out the key from CSI, and use the yoga mats for a quiet reset.
cards.short_summary: A reservable small-group wellness-room session.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wellness Room has yoga mats, permits up to six students per reservation, and is available to students for free.
cards.source_title: Ramapo Wellness Room
cards.access_notes: Students reserve appointments; up to five other students may join one reservation.

cards.entity_name: Light therapy in the Ramapo Wellness Room
cards.title: Try the light therapy lamp
cards.subtitle: Ramapo Wellness Room, E-216
cards.notes: Book the Wellness Room with friends, sign out the key at CSI, and use the listed light therapy lamp during the reservation.
cards.short_summary: A free reservable relaxation session with light therapy.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo lists a light therapy lamp in the Wellness Room and states that the room is free for students.
cards.source_title: Ramapo Wellness Room
cards.access_notes: Student reservation required; appointments are 30 minutes long.

cards.entity_name: Weighted-blanket break in the Ramapo Wellness Room
cards.title: Take a weighted-blanket break
cards.subtitle: Ramapo Wellness Room, E-216
cards.notes: Reserve the room for a calm small-group break and use the weighted blanket as part of its listed relaxation resources.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost, reservable decompression break for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wellness Room includes a weighted blanket and is available to Ramapo students for free.
cards.source_title: Ramapo Wellness Room
cards.access_notes: Student reservation required; up to six students total may attend.

cards.entity_name: Massage chair in the Ramapo Wellness Room
cards.title: Reserve time with the massage chair
cards.subtitle: Ramapo Wellness Room, E-216
cards.notes: Coordinate a Wellness Room appointment, pick up the key from CSI, and take turns using the room’s massage chair.
cards.short_summary: A free student wellness-room session with a massage chair.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo lists a massage chair in the Wellness Room and says the room is free for students.
cards.source_title: Ramapo Wellness Room
cards.access_notes: Student reservation required; follow the key sign-out and return procedure.

cards.entity_name: Coloring activities in the Ramapo Wellness Room
cards.title: Make time for coloring
cards.subtitle: Ramapo Wellness Room, E-216
cards.notes: Reserve the room with a few friends and use its available coloring activities for a slower, screen-free group break.
cards.short_summary: A screen-free wellness-room activity with no fee.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo states that coloring activities are available in the Wellness Room, which is free for students.
cards.source_title: Ramapo Wellness Room
cards.access_notes: Student reservation required; check the current reservation calendar.

cards.title: Join a Togetherall group
cards.subtitle: Online peer-support platform for Ramapo students
cards.notes: Create an account through Ramapo’s Togetherall access, then join a topic-based group or respond supportively to another post.
cards.short_summary: An anonymous online group space available at no charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo says Togetherall is completely free, anonymous, and lets users join topic-based groups.
cards.source_title: Togetherall: 24/7 Peer Support
cards.access_notes: Online service for Ramapo students; anonymous and monitored by mental-health professionals.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten reservable group study rooms in the Peter P. Mercer Learning Commons, selected across the building’s first through fourth floors.

cards.title: LC-113 Group Study Room
cards.subtitle: Peter P. Mercer Learning Commons · first floor
cards.notes: Reserve LC-113 through Ramapo’s room system, then check in within 15 minutes. Use its whiteboard and data/power outlets for a focused group session.
cards.short_summary: A six-seat, reservable first-floor room with whiteboard and power/data access.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo lists Room 113 as a first-floor group study room seating six; study rooms have whiteboards and data/power outlets.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms: Reservations and Usage — George T. Potter Library
cards.access_notes: For current Ramapo students only. Reserve up to two weeks ahead; one reservation per person/group per day, with a two-hour booking and required check-in.

cards.title: LC-120 Group Study Room
cards.subtitle: Peter P. Mercer Learning Commons · first floor
cards.notes: Book LC-120 for a group of up to nine and arrive ready to check in. Leave furniture in place and erase the whiteboard before departing.
cards.short_summary: A nine-seat first-floor group room for reservation-based study.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo lists Room 120 as a first-floor group study room seating nine; its study-room policy requires users to clean whiteboards before leaving.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms: Reservations and Usage — George T. Potter Library
cards.access_notes: For current Ramapo students only. First-floor rooms close at 10:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 6:00 p.m. Friday–Saturday; reservation and check-in required.

cards.title: LC-124 Group Study Room
cards.subtitle: Peter P. Mercer Learning Commons · first floor
cards.notes: Choose LC-124 when your group needs a ten-seat room. Reserve the slot in advance, keep noise low, and use the built-in whiteboard for shared planning.
cards.short_summary: A ten-seat group study room on the Learning Commons’ first floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo lists Room 124 as a first-floor group study room seating ten, and states that all study rooms have whiteboards and data/power outlets.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms: Reservations and Usage — George T. Potter Library
cards.access_notes: For current Ramapo students only. First-floor rooms close at 10:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 6:00 p.m. Friday–Saturday; select a room sized for the group.

cards.title: LC-126 Group Study Room
cards.subtitle: Peter P. Mercer Learning Commons · first floor
cards.notes: Reserve LC-126 for a larger working group and confirm the booking on arrival. Bring collaborative work to the whiteboard, then clear it before you go.
cards.short_summary: Another ten-seat reservable group-study option on the first floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo lists Room 126 as a first-floor group study room seating ten and requires students to check in to confirm reservations.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms: Reservations and Usage — George T. Potter Library
cards.access_notes: For current Ramapo students only. Reservations are two hours by default and are released if not checked in within 15 minutes.

cards.title: LC-228 Group Study Room
cards.subtitle: Peter P. Mercer Learning Commons · second floor
cards.notes: Use LC-228 for a ten-person project session. Reserve it in the online system, check in promptly, and avoid using the room for a scheduled club meeting.
cards.short_summary: A ten-seat group-study room on the Learning Commons’ second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo lists Room 228 as a second-floor group study room seating ten; rooms may not be used for regularly scheduled club meetings or classes.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms: Reservations and Usage — George T. Potter Library
cards.access_notes: For current Ramapo students only. Second-floor rooms close at 10:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 6:00 p.m. Friday–Saturday; reservation required.

cards.title: LC-229 Group Study Room
cards.subtitle: Peter P. Mercer Learning Commons · second floor
cards.notes: Set up a group work block in LC-229 and choose it only if the ten-seat capacity matches your group. Keep personal items attended throughout the reservation.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor, ten-seat room intended for quiet student study.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo lists Room 229 as a second-floor group study room seating ten and says study rooms are intended as quiet places for students to work and study.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms: Reservations and Usage — George T. Potter Library
cards.access_notes: For current Ramapo students only. Book up to two weeks ahead; one reservation per person/group per day and check-in are required.

cards.title: LC-230 Group Study Room
cards.subtitle: Peter P. Mercer Learning Commons · second floor
cards.notes: Reserve LC-230 for a ten-person study group, then use its whiteboard and data/power outlets to keep materials organized. Check out when your work is complete.
cards.short_summary: A reservable, ten-seat room with the Learning Commons’ standard study-room utilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo lists Room 230 as a second-floor group study room seating ten, and states that all study rooms have whiteboards and data/power outlets.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms: Reservations and Usage — George T. Potter Library
cards.access_notes: For current Ramapo students only. Second-floor rooms close at 10:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 6:00 p.m. Friday–Saturday; reservation and checkout apply.

cards.title: LC-331 Group Study Room
cards.subtitle: Peter P. Mercer Learning Commons · third-floor main floor
cards.notes: Plan a group session in LC-331 and reserve before heading over. The room fits up to ten; keep noise at a level that does not disturb other library users.
cards.short_summary: A ten-seat group study room on the Learning Commons’ main floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo lists Room 331 as a third-floor main-floor group study room seating ten and directs users to keep noise levels to a minimum.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms: Reservations and Usage — George T. Potter Library
cards.access_notes: For current Ramapo students only. Third-floor rooms close at midnight Sunday–Thursday and 6:00 p.m. Friday–Saturday; reservation and check-in required.

cards.title: LC-332 Group Study Room
cards.subtitle: Peter P. Mercer Learning Commons · third-floor main floor
cards.notes: Reserve LC-332 for a group of up to ten and confirm your booking through the arrival check-in. Leave the room clean and return any extra seating to its floor.
cards.short_summary: A main-floor, ten-seat option for reservation-based group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo lists Room 332 as a third-floor main-floor group study room seating ten and asks users to return additional seating to the floor when leaving.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms: Reservations and Usage — George T. Potter Library
cards.access_notes: For current Ramapo students only. Reservations may be made two weeks ahead; a missed check-in after 15 minutes makes the room available to others.

cards.title: LC-429 Group Study Room
cards.subtitle: Peter P. Mercer Learning Commons · fourth floor
cards.notes: Book LC-429 for a group project that needs room for up to ten people. Use the data/power outlets and whiteboard, then check out after finishing.
cards.short_summary: A ten-seat fourth-floor group study room in the Peter P. Mercer Learning Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo lists Room 429 as a fourth-floor group study room seating ten; all study rooms have whiteboards and data/power outlets.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms: Reservations and Usage — George T. Potter Library
cards.access_notes: For current Ramapo students only. Fourth-floor rooms close at 10:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 6:00 p.m. Friday–Saturday; reserve and check in.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named public destinations and historic sites along the Ramapo Valley Road (Route 202) corridor near Ramapo College.

cards.title: Ramapo Valley County Reservation
cards.subtitle: Ramapo Valley Road (Route 202) corridor
cards.notes: Use the marked trails for a daylight walk, or consult the county trail information before planning a longer outing.
cards.short_summary: A large Bergen County park with marked hiking trails and Ramapo River access.
cards.evidence_claim: Bergen County identifies this reservation on Ramapo Valley Road and lists marked hiking trails, canoe/kayak access, and access to the Ramapo River.
cards.source_title: Ramapo Valley County Reservation
cards.access_notes: Camping requires a permit; fishing requires an NJ fishing license. Follow posted park rules and trail conditions.

cards.title: Continental Soldier’s Park
cards.subtitle: 550 Ramapo Valley Road corridor
cards.notes: Walk the paved field loop or use the bridges around Lake Henry; bring activity gear if you plan to use courts or fields.
cards.short_summary: A municipal recreation stop with a paved loop, gazebo, playground, and river access.
cards.evidence_claim: Mahwah lists Continental Soldier’s Park at 550 Ramapo Valley Road with a paved path, gazebo, playground, Lake Henry, and Ramapo River access.
cards.source_title: Mahwah Parks & Facilities
cards.access_notes: Use facilities according to municipal rules and any posted field reservations.

cards.title: Hopper Gristmill Site
cards.subtitle: 156 Ramapo Valley Road corridor
cards.notes: Add this historic-site stop to a self-guided local-history route and use the township activity sheet for background.
cards.short_summary: A National Register property included in Mahwah’s children’s self-guided historic-sites tour.
cards.evidence_claim: Mahwah’s Historic Preservation Commission lists the Hopper Gristmill Site at 156 Ramapo Valley Road and includes it among the tour sites.
cards.source_title: Mahwah Historic Preservation Commission: National Register Properties
cards.access_notes: Treat this as a historic-site viewing stop; respect all property boundaries and posted conditions.

cards.title: Hopper–Van Horn House
cards.subtitle: 398 Ramapo Valley Road corridor
cards.notes: Pair this address with the township’s historic-sites materials and view it from public space without entering private property.
cards.short_summary: A named National Register property on the Route 202 corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Mahwah’s Historic Preservation Commission lists the Hopper–Van Horn House at 398 Ramapo Valley Road as a National Register property.
cards.source_title: Mahwah Historic Preservation Commission: National Register Properties
cards.access_notes: View from publicly accessible areas only; do not enter or approach private property.

cards.title: Darlington Schoolhouse
cards.subtitle: 600 Ramapo Valley Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the township’s self-guided history materials to identify the schoolhouse, then continue along the Route 202 corridor.
cards.short_summary: A protected historic schoolhouse listed by Mahwah’s preservation commission.
cards.evidence_claim: Mahwah’s Historic Preservation Commission lists Darlington Schoolhouse at 600 Ramapo Valley Road as a National Register property protected by ordinance.
cards.source_title: Mahwah Historic Preservation Commission: National Register Properties
cards.access_notes: Use public rights-of-way and observe any posted restrictions around the historic property.

cards.title: Crocker-McMillin Mansion
cards.subtitle: Ramapo Valley Road at Campgaw Road corridor
cards.notes: Locate the Ramapo Valley Road and Campgaw Road junction as a history-oriented waypoint; keep all viewing from public areas.
cards.short_summary: A National Register mansion at the Route 202 and Campgaw Road junction.
cards.evidence_claim: Mahwah’s Historic Preservation Commission lists the Crocker-McMillin Mansion at Ramapo Valley Road and Campgaw Road as a National Register property.
cards.source_title: Mahwah Historic Preservation Commission: National Register Properties
cards.access_notes: View from public space only and respect private-property boundaries.

cards.title: Garret Garrison House
cards.subtitle: 980 Ramapo Valley Road corridor
cards.notes: Use this named historic address as a Route 202 photo-reference stop, taking care to remain on public space.
cards.short_summary: The Waternook, a National Register property on the Ramapo Valley Road corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Mahwah’s Historic Preservation Commission lists the Garret Garrison House, also known as Waternook, at 980 Ramapo Valley Road as a National Register property.
cards.source_title: Mahwah Historic Preservation Commission: National Register Properties
cards.access_notes: View from publicly accessible areas only; do not enter private grounds.

cards.title: John Bartholf House
cards.subtitle: 1122 Ramapo Valley Road corridor
cards.notes: Make this the northern history waypoint on a Route 202 route and document the exterior only from permitted public areas.
cards.short_summary: Amberfields, a named National Register property on Ramapo Valley Road.
cards.evidence_claim: Mahwah’s Historic Preservation Commission lists the John Bartholf House, also known as Amberfields, at 1122 Ramapo Valley Road as a National Register property.
cards.source_title: Mahwah Historic Preservation Commission: National Register Properties
cards.access_notes: View from public space only; availability for interior access is not established by the cited source.

cards.entity_name: Continental Soldiers Memorial Highway & W3R-NJ Route
cards.title: Continental Soldiers Memorial Highway
cards.subtitle: Ramapo Valley Road corridor
cards.notes: Look for the official route markers while traveling the corridor and connect the road itself to Mahwah’s Revolutionary War history.
cards.short_summary: A signed historic route designation for Ramapo Valley Road through Mahwah.
cards.evidence_claim: Bergen County states that Ramapo Valley Road was used by Washington’s troops and carries Continental Soldiers Memorial Highway and W3R-NJ Route signs.
cards.source_title: Revolutionary War Sites in Bergen County
cards.access_notes: This is an active road corridor; use designated pedestrian areas and observe traffic rules.

cards.entity_name: Lake Henry and Ramapo River Access at Continental Soldier’s Park
cards.title: Lake Henry and Ramapo River Access
cards.subtitle: Continental Soldier’s Park, Ramapo Valley Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the park’s mulch path and bridges to reach the water-feature area, staying on maintained public paths and observing posted rules.
cards.short_summary: A named water-access feature within the Ramapo Valley Road municipal park.
cards.evidence_claim: Mahwah lists Lake Henry and Ramapo River access, plus a mulch path around the lake with bridges, at Continental Soldier’s Park on Ramapo Valley Road.
cards.source_title: Mahwah Parks & Facilities
cards.access_notes: Stay on maintained public paths; follow municipal signage and water-safety guidance.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Ramapo College of New Jersey, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key first-weekend sequence built around named campus destinations, current student resources, food, art, recreation, and performance options.

cards.title: Start at the Student Center
cards.subtitle: Find the campus hub and its activity information
cards.notes: Begin by locating dining, lounges, club offices, meeting rooms, the bookstore, and Roadrunner Central in one named campus building.
cards.short_summary: Use the Student Center as an orientation point before choosing the rest of the day.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo identifies the Robert C. Scott Student Center as its hub for student life and activities, with club offices, lounges, dining, meeting rooms, and Roadrunner Central.
cards.source_title: Student Center — Ramapo College Virtual Tour
cards.access_notes: Campus destination; check posted building access and event schedules before visiting.

cards.title: Pause for an à la carte meal
cards.subtitle: Robert A. Scott Student Center
cards.notes: Use the Atrium for a practical first meal or snack break, then settle into its lounge area before heading to the next stop.
cards.short_summary: A named Student Center food-court stop designed for students on the go.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo lists The Atrium in the Student Center as a campus hub with lounge areas designed for fast service.
cards.source_title: Dining & Shopping — Ramapo College Virtual Tour
cards.access_notes: Food service and payment options vary; confirm current dining hours and payment methods before going.

cards.title: Walk over to the Bandshell
cards.subtitle: Named outdoor campus destination
cards.notes: Make the Bandshell a short outdoor waypoint and watch the college calendar for student-organization programming scheduled in this campus area.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor landmark that can anchor a campus loop between indoor stops.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo’s campus map lists the Bandshell as a named campus destination, and the Center for Student Involvement depicts students participating in a Holi celebration there.
cards.source_title: Center for Student Involvement — Ramapo College
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access is weather-dependent; attend only scheduled, open events.

cards.title: Check for a club-fair date
cards.subtitle: The Grove
cards.notes: If your weekend overlaps the fair, walk the tables, ask one concrete question at each group, and save contacts for later follow-up.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled way to learn what student groups and campus partners offer.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo’s 2026 Welcome Week schedule says the Student Involvement Fair in the Grove is designed to introduce new students to clubs and organizations and includes more than 100 clubs and organizations.
cards.source_title: Welcome Week 2026 — Ramapo College
cards.access_notes: This is a scheduled Welcome Week activity; confirm the current calendar date and rain plan.

cards.title: Find the Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Named campus learning destination
cards.notes: Use the learning commons as a quiet reset: locate the building, scan available resources, and note where you might return to study.
cards.short_summary: A named academic resource stop for getting oriented to study support.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo’s campus map lists the Peter P. Mercer Learning Commons, and the college describes its Learning Commons as maintaining information resources and providing access assistance and instruction.
cards.source_title: Benefits for Retirees — Ramapo College Retirees Association
cards.access_notes: Check current library/learning-commons building hours and visitor policies before arrival.

cards.title: See the Berrie Center galleries
cards.subtitle: Berrie Center for Performing and Visual Arts
cards.notes: Enter through the Berrie Center, take the stairs or elevator to the middle level, and spend time with the changing contemporary exhibitions.
cards.short_summary: A free, on-campus visual-art stop with published gallery hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo says the Kresge and Pascal Galleries present contemporary exhibitions and that admission to its campus galleries is free; it publishes Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday 1–5 p.m. and Wednesday 1–7 p.m. hours.
cards.source_title: Art Galleries — Berrie Center for Performing and Visual Arts
cards.access_notes: Published hours are Tue/Thu/Fri 1–5 p.m. and Wed 1–7 p.m.; verify exhibition dates and closures.

cards.entity_name: Selden Rodman Gallery of Popular Arts
cards.title: Continue to the Rodman Gallery
cards.subtitle: B Wing, near the Berrie Center galleries
cards.notes: Add the Rodman Gallery to the art walk and look for the continuously presented Haitian-art collection before moving on to recreation.
cards.short_summary: A second free gallery stop centered on Ramapo’s Haitian-art collection.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo states that its Haitian-art collection is continuously presented in the Selden Rodman Gallery of Popular Arts in B Wing and that campus gallery admission is free.
cards.source_title: Art Galleries — Berrie Center for Performing and Visual Arts
cards.access_notes: The page lists Rodman Gallery hours as Tue 1–4:30 p.m. and Wed 1–7 p.m.; verify reopening and exhibition notices.

cards.entity_name: Bill Bradley Sports and Recreation Center
cards.title: Get familiar with the Bradley Center
cards.subtitle: Sports and recreation facilities
cards.notes: Walk to the Bradley Center, identify the fitness, pool, climbing, and court facilities, and check how student access works before planning a workout.
cards.short_summary: A named recreation-building stop for learning the layout and access rules.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo describes the Bill Bradley Sports and Recreation Center as having a fitness center, 25-meter pool, climbing wall, auxiliary gym with basketball courts, and locker room.
cards.source_title: Friends of Ramapo Membership/Benefits
cards.access_notes: Facility entry and activity access may require a Ramapo ID or membership; confirm current recreation rules and hours.

cards.title: Look for an Arch Performance
cards.subtitle: Sharp Theater, Berrie Center
cards.notes: Check the current performance schedule, choose an age-appropriate show, and secure a ticket only after confirming its date, price, and entry requirements.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled arts option in the Sharp Theater rather than an assumed drop-in activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo says Arch Performances presents guest artists in dance, theater, and concerts, and its performance schedule lists events in the Sharp Theater.
cards.source_title: Performance Schedule — Berrie Center for Performing and Visual Arts
cards.access_notes: Programming, ticket prices, and age guidance vary by event; use the current schedule and avoid events marked for adults only.

cards.title: End at J. Lee’s
cards.subtitle: Scott Student Center Annex, second floor
cards.notes: Meet up for pool, ping-pong, video games, or television in the Student Center Annex; confirm that the lounge is open before making it the final stop.
cards.short_summary: A named campus lounge that supports a casual, alcohol-free evening finish.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo’s Winter Welcome 2026 schedule identifies J. Lee’s in the Scott Student Center Annex as a place to play pool, ping-pong, and video games or watch television, and listed 10 a.m.–midnight hours for that program.
cards.source_title: Winter Welcome 2026 — Ramapo College
cards.access_notes: The cited 10 a.m.–midnight hours were for Winter Welcome 2026; verify current lounge hours and entry requirements.
